notes: Lexicon exclusions for the B14 text-graph matcher: each entry removes one folded name segment from one entity's lexicon because the segment is a generic word or duplicates another entity. Excluded mentions stay listed in the report with the reason; nothing is hidden.
Never exclude a segment to make a specific mention disappear: record the judgement as an outcome in review.v1.json instead.
Changing this list means a new file version (exclusions.v2.json); keep earlier versions.
